title: Knowledge freshness manifest
description: Derived, regenerable publication projection stating how far materialized knowledge has caught up with the published archive. Never an authoritative knowledge source.

archive_head_issue.description: Latest issue date published in archive/index.json; empty when no issue is published.

analysis_target_issue.description: Oldest pending issue the analysis queue must work through next; null when knowledge is complete.

materialized_through_issue.description: Latest issue reflected by materialized Roadmap/Idea objects; null when no knowledge object exists.

publication_state.description: archive_only: archive published, no knowledge task prepared. analysis_pending: bounded tasks prepared or executing. knowledge_complete: every affected topic applied or explicitly no-op and watermarks aligned. analysis_failed: operator-marked failure that keeps the previous snapshot readable.

pending_issues.description: Published issues newer than the materialization watermark, in chronological order.

completed_topics.description: Prepared tasks for analysis_target_issue that already have an application record.

candidate_analysis_state.description: Independent Candidate discovery watermark. It never changes the formal knowledge publication_state.

candidate_through_issue.description: Latest issue for which every eligible published item has a Candidate or a reasoned no-op and Topic synthesis is complete.

snapshot_id.description: Derived from the current knowledge/graph.json input digest so manifest, issue diffs, and graph share one snapshot identity.
